name: orch-lite
description: Lightweight orchestration skill for coding sessions. Routes every request into one of three states - chat, task, or resume - so the main agent only coordinates while all file-modifying work runs in background child agents (one feature, one branch, one executor). Use when a request involves writing or modifying files, git/build operations, or coordinating multiple child agents.

interface.shortDescription: Lightweight orchestration: one feature, one branch, one background executor.
interface.longDescription: Use Orch-lite to route every request into one of three states - chat, task, or resume - so the main agent only coordinates while all file-modifying work runs in background child agents (one feature, one branch, one executor).
defaultPrompt: Dispatch this as a background child agent and keep coordinating.
